end.summary: Practised sorting objects by whether they roll, slide, or stack.
end.parentNote: Anika practised using curved surfaces to predict rolling and flat faces to predict sliding or stacking. They first said only balls could roll, then revised this after considering a bottle lying on its side; this correction was seen later in the lesson. At home, gently push a bottle on its side and a flat box, and ask which surface touches the floor.
